errors.evidence: The description interprets the purpose of the chart (evaluating 'effectiveness' and 'reducing' bias) instead of objectively stating what the chart plots (bias percentages before and after a process). The prompt explicitly states to avoid making inferences or drawing conclusions.

errors.text_span: representing “No Contact Before/After,” “Positive Contact Before/After,” and “Negative Contact Before/After,”
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the grouping. The three groups on the x-axis are 'Support of Authorities', 'Extended Contact', and 'Virtual Contact'. Within each of these, there are three bars corresponding to 'No Contact', 'Positive Contact', and 'Negative Contact'. The 'Before/After' distinction applies to the stacked components within each of those bars, not the grouping itself.
